common.appDescription: View your Discogs collection and wantlist with a modern interface.

login.title: Discogs Viewer
login.subtitle: Connect your Discogs account to view your collection and wantlist.
login.oauthNote: This application uses Discogs OAuth to securely access your data.

header.leaveAppConfirm: This will sign you out and delete every piece of Discogs data this app has stored about you. Continue?

about.pageSubtitle: A personal viewer for your Discogs vinyl collection and wantlist.
about.whatThisIs: Discogs Viewer is a personal-scale web application for browsing your own Discogs collection and wantlist with filtering, sorting, and statistics that go beyond what the Discogs site itself offers.
about.attributionNoticeVerbatim: This application uses Discogs' API but is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Discogs.
about.attribExplanationBefore: Discogs® is a registered trademark of Zink Media, LLC. Their public site lives at
about.attribExplanationBetween: and their API terms of use are documented at
about.storeIntro: When you sign in and trigger a sync, the server stores the following data in Redis, keyed by your Discogs username:
about.storeItemCollection: Your collection release list (with folder + notes metadata)
about.storeItemDetails: Per-release and per-master detail metadata for items already in your lists
about.refreshPolicy: To comply with the Discogs API terms of use, cached data is automatically refreshed at least every 6 hours — any page load triggers a re-sync if the last one was longer ago than that. A fresh sync also runs automatically when you sign in.
about.tokensPolicy: Ephemeral job state (sync progress) lives in Redis with a 1-hour expiry. No copy of your Discogs OAuth tokens is written to disk; they live only inside the encrypted session cookie described below.
about.retentionPolicy: All cached user data is kept for 90 days from the last sync. If you stop using the app, your data will expire automatically without any action on your part.
about.sharingPolicy: No analytics or third-party trackers are loaded. No data is shared with any party other than Discogs (whose API returned it).
about.cookieBody1prefix: A single HTTP-only, encrypted session cookie named
about.cookieBody1suffix: is used to keep you signed in. It expires 8 hours after issue and is not readable by JavaScript. It carries your Discogs OAuth access token and username so the server can talk to Discogs on your behalf; it is not used for advertising or tracking.
about.cookieBody2: This is a functional cookie required for the application to work. No consent banner is shown for it because no non-functional cookies are set.
about.removeSignOutAfter: from the header menu — this destroys the session cookie immediately, but keeps your cached Discogs data around for next time you sign in.
about.removeLeaveAfter: from the same menu — this signs you out and deletes every piece of Discogs data this app has stored about you, all in one action.
about.removeGithubIssueBefore: If anything still lingers after that, you can request a manual full purge by opening an issue on the
about.thirdPartyBody: Item cards link out to their release pages on discogs.com. No other third-party services are contacted.
